create_image_widget: create a QtStimulus image widget with a specified filename, duration, width, and height
create_image_widget_with_position: create an image widget with a fixed position instead of random placement on screen
create_image_widget_with_pkg: create an image widget that loads a filename from a specific package path
create_image_widget_delayed: create an image widget that starts displaying after a specified delay time
review_get_image_widget: review the get_image_widget function to understand how it configures QtStimulus callbacks for image display
